subject: food-technology
title: Kitchen Equipment
welcome_lead: Whisks, sieves and the tools every kitchen needs.
meta_desc: KS3 food: small equipment and uses.
final_note: The right tool makes cooking faster and better.

concepts.def: Tool to mix and add air.
Tool with rough holes to shred.

walkthroughs.body_html: A whisk mixes liquids and adds air (whipped cream, beaten egg). A wooden spoon stirs in pans without scratching non-stick and stays cool to touch.
A sieve separates lumps from flour, drains pasta, strains stock. Sieving flour adds air and stops lumps in your cake batter.
Scales measure dry ingredients in grams. A measuring jug measures liquids in millilitres. Baking is a science — measure exactly.
